Defined by multiple colorectal serrated/hyperplastic polyps; associated cancers are separate diseases or uncommon.
Primary gallbladder carcinoma; neuroendocrine differentiation alone does not establish endocrine gland disease.
Myeloid blood and marrow malignancy defined by monosomy 5; AML alone does not establish an immune-mediated mechanism.
Small-intestinal stasis and bacterial overgrowth cause malabsorption; overgrowth alone is not infection. Osteoporosis and stones are separate complications.
